articles.title: U.S. agencies seek stablecoin customer-ID rules akin to banks in new GENIUS Act pitch
articles.snippet: The Federal Reserve, Treasury and other regulators have issued a proposed rule that would set identification standards, and it's now open for public comments.

articles.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
articles.snippet: The AgentCard integration with Visa Intelligent Commerce allows AI agents built on models from any provider, including OpenAI or Anthropic, to effect commercial transactions.

articles.title: The great rotation: Investors desert the Magnificent 7, crypto for AI bottlenecks
articles.snippet: Capital is flowing out of the largest tech companies and bitcoin as investors pile into semiconductors, memory stocks and space-related opportunities.

articles.title: Bitcoin tipped for $66K top as trader flags 'suspicious' BTC price gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin pushed for a $64,000 reclaim despite the US-Iran war making a partial comeback and Binance spot sellers keeping up pressure from earlier in the week.

articles.title: Dash eyes Philippines as market for crypto payments
articles.snippet: Dash is assessing the Philippines for a crypto payments push as regulators promote easier business registration, though industry participants say compliant market entry can still take years.
